model.title: ACRES Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee, Agriculture Committee, Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Thomas Tiffany (R-WI)

summary.text: The bill would require the Department of Agriculture and the Department of the Interior to report each year on how many acres of federal land had hazardous fuels reduction work done on them during the previous year, and to include that report with the President's budget materials. It would also require both departments to set up standard procedures for tracking that work, including regular checks on whether the data is accurate and entered on time, methods to confirm the data matches the work actually done, an analysis of how well the work reduces wildfire risk over the short and long term, and ways to separate acres inside the wildland-urban interface from those outside it. Finally, the Government Accountability Office would study how the bill is carried out and report its findings to Congress.
